tagline: Your notes, on your own axis
brief: A local-first desktop knowledge base: notes stay as plain Markdown files on your own machine, with links, a graph, grids, canvases, handwriting and optional AI using your own keys. For students, researchers and heavy note-takers.
criteria: Success: distinct from the category's blue/purple gems, graphs and brains; recognisable at 16 px; works in one colour and reversed; carries the name AXIS or the idea of an axis.

concepts.name: Lambda A
concepts.idea: An A whose crossbar is a single point: the one idea you're holding.
rationale: Carries the name; builds recognition of AXIS directly
Strongest at 16 px: the A and the point both survive
The signal point is a reusable accent (cursor, bullets, loading)

concepts.name: Origin
concepts.idea: Two axes and one plotted point: your notes start from your own origin.
rationale: The most literal 'axis': precise and grounded
Axes and point extend into a grid pattern for the brand
Risk: can read as an analytics or charting product

concepts.name: Own axis
concepts.idea: A ring split by a bar at Earth's 23.4° tilt: your world on its own axis.
rationale: A specific, ownable detail with a real story
Dynamic diagonal stands out on a shelf of square icons
Risk: reads as the empty-set symbol ∅

recommendation: Lambda A: it names the product, stays clear at every size, and its signal point grows into a small system of accents.
next_steps: Final refinements and the app's icons replaced
Guidelines handed over with the master files
